class Solution:
    def minCostGoodCaption(self, caption: str) -> str:
        n = len(caption)
        
        if n > 0 and n < 3:
            return ""
        if n == 0:
            return ""

        infinity = float('inf')
        
        prefix_cost = [[0] * 26 for _ in range(n + 1)]
        ord_a = ord('a')
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            char_ord_val = ord(caption[i - 1]) - ord_a
            for c_ord in range(26):
                prefix_cost[i][c_ord] = prefix_cost[i - 1][c_ord] + abs(char_ord_val - c_ord)

        cost = [infinity] * (n + 1)
        parent = [-1] * (n + 1)
        char_val = [-1] * (n + 1)
        cost[0] = 0
        
        M = [[0] * 26 for _ in range(n + 1)]

        MAX_LOG_N = (n + 1).bit_length()
        depth = [-1] * (n + 1)
        up = [[0] * MAX_LOG_N for _ in range(n + 1)]
        depth[0] = 0

        def compare_strings(i, j):
            if i == j: return 0
            if i == 0: return -1
            if j == 0: return 1

            swapped = False
            if depth[i] < depth[j]:
                i, j = j, i
                swapped = True

            i_orig, j_orig = i, j

            # Lift i to the same depth as j
            diff = depth[i] - depth[j]
            for k in range(MAX_LOG_N - 1, -1, -1):
                if (diff >> k) & 1:
                    i = up[i][k]

            if i == j:
                return 1 if swapped else -1

            for k in range(MAX_LOG_N - 1, -1, -1):
                if up[i][k] != up[j][k]:
                    i, j = up[i][k], up[j][k]
            
            res = 0
            if char_val[i] < char_val[j]:
                res = -1
            elif char_val[i] > char_val[j]:
                res = 1
            
            return -res if swapped else res
        
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if i >= 3:
                best_cost = infinity
                best_j, best_c_ord = -1, -1
                
                for c_ord in range(26):
                    j = M[i - 3][c_ord]
                    
                    if cost[j] == infinity: continue
                    
                    current_cost = cost[j] + (prefix_cost[i][c_ord] - prefix_cost[j][c_ord])

                    if current_cost < best_cost:
                        best_cost = current_cost
                        best_j, best_c_ord = j, c_ord
                    elif current_cost == best_cost:
                        cmp_res = compare_strings(j, best_j)
                        if cmp_res < 0:
                            best_j, best_c_ord = j, c_ord
                        elif cmp_res == 0 and c_ord < best_c_ord:
                            best_j, best_c_ord = j, c_ord
                
                if best_cost != infinity:
                    cost[i] = best_cost
                    parent[i] = best_j
                    char_val[i] = best_c_ord

            if cost[i] != infinity:
                p = parent[i]
                depth[i] = depth[p] + 1
                up[i][0] = p
                for k in range(1, MAX_LOG_N):
                    if up[i][k-1] == -1: break
                    up[i][k] = up[up[i][k - 1]][k - 1]

            for c_ord in range(26):
                j_old = M[i - 1][c_ord] if i > 0 else 0
                M[i][c_ord] = j_old
                if cost[i] != infinity:
                    j_new = i
                    cost_diff_old = cost[j_old] - prefix_cost[j_old][c_ord]
                    cost_diff_new = cost[i] - prefix_cost[i][c_ord]
                    
                    if cost_diff_new < cost_diff_old:
                        M[i][c_ord] = j_new
                    elif cost_diff_new == cost_diff_old:
                        if compare_strings(j_new, j_old) < 0:
                            M[i][c_ord] = j_new

        if cost[n] == infinity:
            return ""

        res = []
        curr = n
        while curr > 0:
            p = parent[curr]
            c = chr(ord_a + char_val[curr])
            length = curr - p
            res.append(c * length)
            curr = p
        
        return "".join(reversed(res))
